inlines.v: GAV'ELET, noun An ancient and special cessavit in Kent, in England, where the custom of gavelkind continues, by which the tenant, if he withdraws his rent and services due to his lord, forfeits his lands and tenements. 1. In London, a writ used in the hustings, given to lords or rents in the city.
